text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can produce art, music, and writing that look and sound surprisingly human. Some people worry that machines will replace artists and writers. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI learns from millions of examples, but it cannot feel emotions or understand life experience. Human creativity comes from feelings, memories, and imagination. AI can support our work and give us new ideas, but it cannot replace the human touch. In the end, the best results may come from people and machines working together.
